title: Frame a capture region — pz_frame
text: pz_frame() builds lazy framing spec capture: region computed capture time, padded, nudged, grown aspect ratio, clamped. Every capture takes one: screenshots pz_screenshot(frame =), recordings pz_record_start(frame =), camera shots pz_camera(frame =). Wherever frame accepted, bare locator (CSS selector string, pz_loc() spec, list either) promoted pz_frame(<locator>). Every field defaults NULL, meaning "inherit": capture time unset field takes pz_stage_frame() value one staged, else built-default. built-defaults pad = 0, offset = c(0, 0), anchor = "center", = "stop", target_box = "element", ratio, bounds, zoom, target unset. Camera shots never inherit staged frame; built-defaults pad = 24 target_box = "element". framed region computed order: Union bounding boxes target's matched elements. target_box = "annotated", include attached annotations. Expand pad. zoom = NULL, shift offset, grow shorter side reach ratio (never shrink), placing content anchor. numeric zoom, region view divided zoom (viewport stills recordings, recording's home frame camera shots), ratio setting aspect given; padded target placed inside anchor, shifted offset. Clamp bounds page's rendered area. Round whole pixels.

text: target element(s) frame computed : CSS selector string, pz_loc() spec, list either (frame union matched elements' bounding boxes). NULL frames current scope's box, viewport root. ... Checked empty; reserved future use. ratio Width/height ratio region, e.g. 16/9. NULL disables aspect-ratio expansion, keeping region tight content. Ignored (warning) camera shots. pad Padding CSS pixels: one number sides, c(top, right, bottom, left). Negative values crop inside content box. offset Nudge region c(x, y) pixels, applied pad. anchor content sits region grows around : "center", side ("top", "bottom", "left", "right"), corner ("top left", "top right", "bottom left", "bottom right"). Case-insensitive; "top right", "right top", "top-right" equivalent. bounds target (CSS selector string, pz_loc() spec, list either) whose union box region clamped within. NULL adds bounds target; page's rendered area still limits region. recording measures frame: "stop" (default) measures final layout; "start" clips capture start. Screenshots ignore ; camera shots warn. target_box "element" (default) measures matched elements. "annotated" also includes painted marks, callouts, spotlight cutouts attached elements descendants; redactions annotations unrelated elements excluded. Applies stills camera shots, recording's home frame. zoom Magnification relative full view (viewport stills recordings, recording's home frame camera shots). NULL fits region target plus pad, grown ratio. number fixes region size view divided zoom; anchor places padded target inside . Stills crop , never upscale: zoomed still smaller PNG page's pixel ratio. camera caps fitted shot capture's pixel density; explicit zoom past warns encode time.
